svg.title: Makkah, papercut look, 1.8 km view
svg.desc: Exported from the Murshid Papercut scene. Stand-in buildings, not real map data; ground from Copernicus elevation. Every colour is a plain hex fill, so Find and Replace or Select Same Fill Colour works. Side faces have a separate black overlay for shading. Colours: hotel #B7CD9B, shop #EFC086, home #f7efe2, mosque #E49468, tower #60998A, kaabah #26324d, node #623C00, layer-4 (ground) #ECDEC4, layer-5 #EAE6C9, layer-6 #e9dba0, mataf floor #f7efe2
